risks.note: The statutory auditor carried an Emphasis of Matter: the Company has received Show Cause-cum-Demand Notices from the Department of Telecommunications towards licence fee on Adjusted Gross Revenue for financial years ranging from FY 2005-06 to FY 2024-25 and has disclosed H 7,513.71 crores as contingent liability. Individual demands (H875.80 crore, H992 crore, H6,159 crore, and others) are contested before TDSAT, which has directed DoT not to take coercive action pending final disposal; matters remain pending adjudication and DoT's cross-appeals sit before the Supreme Court. An adverse outcome would be material relative to annual profit.
risks.risk: DoT licence-fee / AGR demands — the single largest quantified exposure

risks.note: Indian tax authorities have not accepted certain historical tax-holiday and expense claims and in a few instances have sought penalties; disallowances and penalties are at various stages of appeal. Management states that although no appeal has been finally decided against the Company, in the unlikely event all disputes were decided against it there could be adverse financial implications on the business.
risks.risk: Disputed tax matters from past tax-holiday and expense claims

risks.note: Global slowdown, inflation, rising interest rates, currency volatility, trade tariffs and geopolitical uncertainty may affect operations across multiple geographies. Early-warning indicators reviewed during the year included potential tariff changes in the United States and Mexico, Indo-Pak tensions, China's rare-earth export controls, instability in the Middle East and the Red Sea cable cut incident. Management also flags that geopolitical conflict could disrupt subsea cables and global routes, slow economic growth and delay IT investment.
risks.risk: Macroeconomic and geopolitical exposure across many jurisdictions (Strategic Risk in the register)

risks.note: Traffic migration and revenue continuity may be affected if alternate cable capacity is not made available in a timely manner. Separately, subsea cable disruptions such as the recent Red Sea cable cuts can cause latency spikes, traffic rerouting, temporary service degradation, higher operating costs and increased network vulnerability. Mitigation relies on alternate routes, backup capacity and prioritised capacity enhancement — all of which carry capital cost.
risks.risk: Physical connectivity disruption and cables reaching end of life (Operational Risk in the register)

risks.note: Growing data exchange across expanding digital ecosystems and accelerating AI adoption increase exposure to cyber threats, data breaches and system vulnerabilities. Because the Company both operates critical network infrastructure and sells security services, a breach carries direct financial, regulatory and reputational consequences. Compliance obligations include the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and other applicable privacy laws.
risks.risk: Cybersecurity and data-privacy breach (register risk and a stated sector threat)

risks.note: Rapid advances in Agentic AI, quantum computing, network APIs and multi-modal, data-centric networking require continuous innovation and upgrades. Ineffective integration of AI and emerging technologies into products and processes, insufficient reskilling, and evolving regulatory standards could adversely impact operational resilience, compliance, service reliability and long-term competitive advantage. An AI Committee has been constituted to oversee governance, compliance and technology integration.
risks.risk: Technology obsolescence and AI-transition execution (Technology Risk in the register)

risks.note: Despite rising data consumption, sector revenue growth remains moderate with pricing pressure and high capital investment weighing on profitability. EBITDA margin at 19.4% was marginally lower because of the mix shift toward higher-growth digital services, and management states that achieving sustainable profitability in digital services will require continued scale, cost optimisation and disciplined execution of product roadmaps — i.e. the growth engine is currently margin-dilutive.
risks.risk: Pricing pressure and thin digital-services profitability

risks.note: Foreign currency volatility, interest rate fluctuations and dependence on external capital markets may influence financial stability; the Company hedges with derivative instruments and monitors net debt to EBITDA. The standalone debt-equity ratio rose to 0.45x from 0.31x, an increase management attributes mainly to borrowings availed during the year, while interest coverage fell to 5.19x from 6.78x.
risks.risk: Financial risk: forex, interest rates and rising leverage
